purpose: Generate the owner-account GPT-5.6 Sol voter baseline from the frozen full environment plus a reproducible exact-SHA anonymous political-context overlay sourced from main, while preserving E0 and preserving historical blinding.

baseline_roles.E0_DETERMINISTIC: retained immutable mechanics/control baseline; never relabeled as LLM output
baseline_roles.G0_CHATGPT_GPT56_SOL_MAIN_BRIDGE_V1: candidate primary isolated GPT baseline using the frozen full environment plus M26_AS_MAIN_BRIDGE_V1

execution.resume_semantics: rerun identical command; validated work items are skipped; Codex threads are never resumed

main_bridge.candidate_layer: already-blinded pre-cutoff E_reason candidate/event evidence from exact main SHA, with explicit missingness/conflicts/source provenance
main_bridge.programme_layer: existing frozen anonymous programme-priority cards are preserved in V1; a separate complete historical manifesto corpus is not claimed
main_bridge.overlap_interpretation: If main reproduces a feature already present in the frozen environment, the bridge establishes exact upstream provenance but must not count the duplicate as additional independent evidence.
main_bridge.future_delta_rule: A later main SHA or richer manifesto/candidate representation requires a reviewed new bridge snapshot/protocol before any affected G0 output is generated.

information_boundary.input: only the frozen scientific prompt, row schema, one frozen work item, and the corresponding frozen M26_AS_MAIN_BRIDGE_V1 anonymous overlay item

output_transport.scientific_row_schema: read verbatim from the frozen environment

D0_DECISION.role: freeze turnout and party probabilities before narrative explanation

L0_OBSERVABLE_DELIBERATION.role: fresh-context structured explanation of immutable D0 tied to a closed evidence catalogue

CF_BEHAVIOURAL_ABLATIONS.role: fresh-context reruns of preregistered packet perturbations plus a non-political placebo

promotion_gate: one frozen Sol model and reasoning effort for every D0 work item
one frozen M26_AS_MAIN_BRIDGE_V1 overlay generated from the registered exact main SHA
bridge PASS status and leak scan PASS
bridge file SHA and per-item SHA folded into every work-item source provenance
ChatGPT-managed auth and no API key
all identities, row order, party keys, factor keys and simplexes valid
complete per-work-item output hashes and usage logs

frontend_policy.before_G0_promotion: continue labeling public numbers as E0 deterministic reference
frontend_policy.after_G0_promotion: G0 becomes primary displayed simulation; E0 remains available as deterministic control
frontend_policy.after_deliberation_promotion: show structured explanations and separately labelled counterfactual diagnostics
frontend_policy.never_claim: that G0, bridge evidence, or a fluent explanation is empirically true before blind historical scoring
frontend_policy.social_lambdas: remain illustrative until separate 2016 calibration and 2021 holdout
